title: SEKAI YUGO V1 is officially live!
author: Miserable_Reach_9364
selftext:
After a lot of work, **SEKAI YUGO has officially launched in V1**.

The game is still actively evolving, and I’d really like to get feedback from people who haven’t been testing it from the inside.

If you try it, I’d love to hear your thoughts on:

* progression
* combat
* balancing
* summons
* team building
* UI/UX
* events
* PvE / PvP
* anything that feels confusing, frustrating or could be improved

Suggestions are also very welcome. If you think a system could be better, tell me what you would change.

🎮 **Play SEKAI YUGO:**  
[https://sekaiyugo.eu](https://sekaiyugo.eu/)

💬 **Join the Discord community:**  
[https://discord.gg/8hafE6Gtm7](https://discord.gg/8hafE6Gtm7)

Even a short first impression helps a lot. Thanks to everyone who gives it a try!
